candidate_audit.reason: with recipient fixed, choosing one of two transverse donors is exactly one bit; it is a coordinate-free representation of h.

candidate_audit.conditional: It is sufficient only if its frozen transformation law contains a tau-odd two-state distinction equivalent to h. Without that exact typed map, it is not evidence for a selector.

candidate_audit.condition: If its exact Boolean solution set for the current bit is singleton, legality itself forces b. If the set is {0,1}, ambiguity remains. It can be stronger than the one-bit continuation memory.

minimum_result.initialization_boundary: h=b_k exists only after a branch has already been realized. The law does not determine b_0.
minimum_result.minimality: A deterministic equivariant continuation selector needs at least two context states at the symmetric local input; one Boolean bit realizes exactly two and is therefore minimum cardinality.
minimum_result.one_bit_context: SUFFICIENT when h is the previous complementary branch bit and transforms h->1-h under transverse exchange.
